create.title: Hard-TOP t=1 residual whole-chain scale-coboundary and positive-capacity obstruction
create.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt(X), y=floor(J), H=floor(yX^(-1/4)), 1<<L<<H<=J^(1/2), R_0=ceil(L), M asymp L^2, and retain the complete literal residual sequence z_N=c_N^rem e(Jsqrt(N)), zero-extended on the full integer line, with D_L=sum_N|z_N|^2<<_epsilon L^2X^epsilon. Retain both absolute-parity branches, the exact cardinal character/ordinary-frequency transform, every odd character frequency, and the nonzero ordinary-frequency part Z_(epsilon,*). For the minimal stopped chain R_(j+1)=min(2R_j,M), with the actual strict final link when present, define Q_R^*=(1/2)sum_(epsilon=0)^1 int_0^1 F_R(theta)|Z_(epsilon,*)(theta)|^2dtheta>=0 and let N_(R,S) be the complete transformed nonzero-ordinary-frequency link, including constants i/2 and 1/8 and one outer real part. Then exactly N_(R,S)=Q_S^*-Q_R^* and sum_(j<K)N_(R_j,R_(j+1))=Q_M^*-Q_(R_0)^*. More generally sum_j a_jN_j=a_(K-1)Q_M^*-a_0Q_(R_0)^*+sum_(j=1)^(K-1)(a_(j-1)-a_j)Q_(R_j)^*. Thus constant weights erase every interior scale and nonconstant scalar scale weights change the target. The normalized exact-doubling Haar decrease Q_(2R)^*/(2R)=Q_R^*/R-H_R^*/(2R) restores the top factor when returned to the unweighted endpoint; a strict terminal link uses its exact Fejer difference. The collectively recombined ordinary-zero-containing sector Z_(R_0,M) and the once-only short correction B_short each satisfy <<_epsilon L^3X^epsilon, and exact physical restoration gives sum_(j<K)N_j=2(T_26+B_short)-Z_(R_0,M), where T_26 is exactly the open K26 scalar. Also Q_(R_0)^*<<_epsilon L^3X^epsilon, so the one-sided whole-chain target is equivalent at target strength to the still-open literal positive theorem Q_M^*<<_epsilon L^3X^epsilon and hence to K26 modulo the paid seams. Coefficient-independent positivity supplies only Q_M^*<<_epsilon ML^2X^epsilon<<_epsilon L^4X^epsilon. An admissible dechirped even-site physical array has endpoint increment at least L^4/12, and an abstract positive-operator array has top-link increment MD/8; neither is a literal cardinal image or physical lower mass for c_N^rem. The exact squarefree and selector factors give no automatic sign saving; selected opposite-character rows pair disjoint near-square supports and supply no pointwise L^(-1), no-pair all-1 mod 4 rows are only an allowed-support warning, and the full zero-extended profile has total variation O(1). Therefore treating the scale index as an independent cancellation resource, scalar scale Abel/Haar/martingale closure, or coefficient-uniform positivity before a proved actual-symbol gain cannot supply the missing factor L. This route-scoped obstruction does not exclude a direct complete literal signed endpoint theorem, a selector-stable joint transform, or a coefficient-sensitive positive theorem, and it neither proves nor disproves K26 or any downstream owner.
create.next_action: Park cross-link scale cancellation as an independent resource, scalar scale Abel/Haar/martingale closure, and coefficient-uniform positive closure before an actual-symbol gain. Resume K26 only through a complete literal coefficient-sensitive theorem for Q_M^*<<_epsilon L^3X^epsilon, or its exact physical signed endpoint equivalent, retaining every parity, frequency, cell, opening, endpoint, transition, zero-extension, ordinary-zero, and short-correction seam.

The K26 whole-chain scale index is not an independent cancellation variable: the exact chain is Q_M^*-Q_(R_0)^*, the lower endpoint is target-safe, and the target is equivalent to the still-open literal positive maximal-energy theorem Q_M^*<<_epsilon L^3X^epsilon. Park scalar scale Abel/Haar/martingale and coefficient-uniform positive closure. The open owner requires a new complete literal coefficient-sensitive endpoint theorem, while every other density-discrepancy channel remains separate.

Retain the complete hard-TOP signed-cone owner. On its K26 residual route, the unweighted whole-chain transform is exactly one endpoint difference and the lower endpoint, collectively restored ordinary-zero sector, and once-only short correction are target-safe. The missing theorem is the literal coefficient-sensitive top endpoint bound Q_M^*<<_epsilon L^3X^epsilon, equivalently K26 at target strength. All other t=1 and few-point channels remain independent.

reject.reason: The exact telescope identifies the chain with a positive endpoint difference but supplies no L^3 bound for the top endpoint.
For the unweighted target every interior scale cancels algebraically, leaving only Q_M^*-Q_(R_0)^*.
Nonconstant weights introduce intermediate positive energies and estimate a different scalar; restoring constant weights returns the endpoint telescope.
The lower endpoint is nonnegative and already O_epsilon(L^3X^epsilon), so it cannot fund a possible top-scale L^4 contribution.
The selected-row pairing has disjoint near-square supports and prevents pointwise cancellation; the actual profile supplies neither an L^(-1) factor nor lower mass.
The squarefree and coprimality factors are nonnegative projectors or recombine to literal zero, not signed savings.
The full zero-extended profile has total variation O(1), including hard births, deaths, point values, and endpoint jumps.
The coherent even-site array is a coefficient-insensitive capacity diagnostic, not the literal residual coefficient.
The abstract positive-operator array need not lie in the image of the exact literal cardinal transform.
Physical gaps and transformed tuples are distinct ledgers; fixed dual diagonals cancel only after complete recombination.
The obstruction eliminates only scale-only and coefficient-uniform closures; a direct complete literal coefficient-sensitive theorem remains possible.
K26, the complete residual scalar, other hard-TOP channels, and every parent remain open.
A route obstruction proves no analytic parent, bridge, quarter theorem, or exponent improvement.
